## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 6, 2026 - Jul 19, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Ldycsi_, Jul 19, 2026, 1/5: "Last update made it glitchy, slow, and can’t search for foods. Have to add everything. Useless unless you pay them. I’ve been using the app for years. I felt loyal to it bc I dropped a ton of weight and got healthy with this as a tool. That’s over, I guess. What a pain in my a— it has become to log things! No thanks. I’ll find something else that isn’t seeking money people do not have to waste on a logging app that has ads! How much do you greedy b—ds need?!"
            2. _jT20uk_, Jul 7, 2026, 1/5: "The new interface is very Lagi and very slow. It really puts me off from wanting to use the app or subscribe to premium I don’t know why they changed it when the old version was working perfectly fine they have made this really bad."
            3. _Chuck 1307_, Jul 19, 2026, 3/5: "I loved this app at first. I still like it but it has some issues. It tracks well and works with my garmin watch to help log my strength training and cardio. That only would give it 5 stars. It has all kinds of foods in its data base to help log ur calories. Where it lost 2 stars is from every month or 2 it glitches out and I have to uninstall then reinstall and the price is really high. Right now it could find any foods and wouldn’t track my cardio so I uninstalled and reinstalled and now it doesn’t recognize my account. Please fix and I’ll update the review."

## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Pricing and paywall.**
      5 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jul 19, 2026 - Jul 20, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _N.Schn_, Jul 20, 2026, 1/5: "Updated app about a week ago and the new interface is unintuitive, clunky, and a massive downgrade from the streamlined interface that we’ve had for years. It’s bad enough I’ve cancelled my premium and am looking for alternatives."
            2. _Nathannn98_, Jul 19, 2026, 1/5: "You might have a fine experience with this app, but mine only worked for a day. I had the free trial and then was set to renew, so I had the premium. First day it worked fine (searching food/barcodes etc) but then next morning it only allowed me to add food through manual entry, didn’t let me search existing brands etc (only options were history and my meals/food or to add manually). App still showed I had premium. I tried to contact support but the bot was zero help. No way to talk to a human except to ‘submit feedback’. I did, but no way to get a timely reply. After that I thought maybe try to delete/redownload the app, but when I downloaded again and tried to sign in, it said my account wasn’t found (I signed up using Apple ID and system let me autofill my login using Apple) definitely cancelling my free trial. Very frustrating since I was really excited to use it again today and track my meals. Gonna have to go to a competitor probably."
            3. _Akiko1993_, Jul 19, 2026, 3/5: "I’ll give more stars if my app starts to work better. I was trying to update a recipe and it just started giving me an error message and also won’t scan anything in. I will try to uninstall and reinstall but if it still doesn’t work, I will cancel my subscription. This is suppose to make losing weight easy and so far it has for the few months I’ve been paying for it, but when I’m trying to meal prep and make my own recipes, it’s disappointing when I just keep getting error messages."
